english.note: Use 病 as the all-purpose noun for a physical disease or illness in people, animals, or plants.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zung2 beng6 hou2 ji6 cyun4 jim5

english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an illness, disease, or generally being in bad health.

exampleSentences.english: I've been dealing with illness a lot lately.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 seng4 jat6 beng6

english.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for illness or the state of being sick.

exampleSentences.english: This sickness has kept me in bed for several days.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢場病搞到我瞓咗幾日床。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 coeng4 beng6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan3 zo2 gei2 jat6 cong4

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical illness or disease.

exampleSentences.english: This malady has dragged on for months, and they still haven't recovered.

english.note: Use this everyday broad medical noun for a physical or mental condition rather than a technical diagnosis.

exampleSentences.english: I don't know what disorder they have, but they suffer from insomnia all the time.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我唔知佢有咩病，但係成日失眠。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 jau5 me1 beng6 daan6 hai6 seng4 jat6 sat1 min4

english.note: Use 病 when condition means an illness or abnormal health problem itself, rather than the patient's current status.

exampleSentences.english: This condition isn't an ordinary cold.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個病唔係普通傷風感冒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 beng6 m4 hai6 pou2 tung1 soeng1 fung1 gam2 mou6
